LESSON: STRUCTURE OF THE ATOM

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Mixtures, Elements, and Compounds
Topic 1.1: Structure of the atom

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Structure of the atom
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How is the structure of the atom important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe the structure of the atom
2. draw the electron arrangement in atoms using dot or cross diagrams
3. classify elements into metals and non- metals
4. show interest in classifying elements into metals and non- metals

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Structure of the atom

Teach
• Observe Structure of the atom in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Structure of the atom (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Structure of the atom.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Structure of the atom.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Structure of the atom.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• describe the structure of the atom
• draw the electron arrangement in atoms using dot or cross diagrams
• classify elements into metals and non- metals

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Structure of the atom.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Structure of the atom: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How is the structure of the atom important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• describe the structure of the atom
• draw the electron arrangement in atoms using dot or cross diagrams
• classify elements into metals and non- metals
• show interest in classifying elements into metals and non- metals

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
